text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just before the Yasuda Kinen—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: —WOOOOOAAHHH!!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Haah... haah... haah...! Not yet, damn 
it...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As the Yasuda Kinen drew closer, the fiery 
spirit in Bamboo Memory's training surged 
without end...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Piece of cake! In fact, I'm feeling better 
than ever!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'm more fired up than ever! Though, 
that's only natural, right?! Because—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Oguri-senpai is without a doubt the 
strongest opponent! There's no way I can 
beat her unless I train beyond my limits!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Let's push it right to the 
limit!! I can still keep going!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I marvel at how that's just like Bamboo 
Memory. She's right, Oguri Cap is the 
strongest opponent. If we don't push past 
our limits right here and now, when will 
we!
choice_data_list: It's going to burn even hotter!
It's going to burn even hotter!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yes, sir!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Heheh— I gotta thank Oguri-senpai...! 
Thanks to her, I'm burning up like this—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I see...!! So that's what it was all 
about...!!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Trainer. I—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I can reach Yaeno not just through 
my running, but with words too...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then came the day of the Yasuda Kinen—

text_block_list.name: Oguri's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
—I can't wait! To see Oguri win! I wonder 
how she's gonna hype everyone up today!

text_block_list.name: Oguri's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Daddy! Can you see Oguri from here? Take a 
picture of me crossing the finish line in 
1st place!

text_block_list.name: Oguri's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Prove that you're the strongest at the 
mile, Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...It's finally starting, isn't it? The 
Yasuda Kinen, where Bamboo-san and 
Yaeno-san will run alongside Oguri-san.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
We're sure to find out in this race. How 
we—how Yaeno-san— ought to exist in this 
era—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...If it's Bamboo-san, I'm sure she can.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, without a doubt. It will surely show 
us once again what we had lost sight of 
before.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: —I leave it in your hands.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... Her presence feels even more 
commanding than before—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Just how far does she intend to go...! 
That lady...!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Oooooh...!! You're in insane shape...!! 
That's Oguri-senpai for you!!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Aren't you afraid, Bamboo-san?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Her intimidation factor is definitely 
downright scary, yeah!! But that's what 
makes it so awesome!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno! Best of luck today!! I'm gonna hit 
ya with everything my running's got!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'm heading over to where 
Oguri-senpai is!! See ya!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Bamboo-san—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: —Oguri-senpai!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Bamboo.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Being able to run with you today, Senpai! 
I was suuuuuper looking forward to it!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
With heart and soul, I'm aiming for 
victory!! I look forward to working with 
you today!!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah. I'm going in with everything 
I've got to win, too. Let's make it a 
great race."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ...!! Yes, ma'am!!
